editorial.blurb: Serai serves authentic Malaysian cuisine in a spacious, no-frills setting with excellent service and standout dishes like curry laksa and lamb rendang.
editorial.insiderTip: The restaurant shares a location with Kapitan and the "Serai" sign is hard to spot—look for the prominent "Kapitan" signage on the building to find it. Come when you're not in a rush, as noodle dishes can dry out quickly if left sitting.
